objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction or other document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, invalidated, or reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation for the document type or document.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Assigned consecutive number of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document validity starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document is valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate extended validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which archived documents are retained.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope printed or maintained for the document.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Relevant companies or areas of validity maintained in document properties.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or from which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: External file or document uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_format
objs.description: Standard MS Office format used to generate new documents.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted representation of a saved document displayed on the web.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for a document.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of attributes and metadata according to their purpose.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Reference maintained via document properties and used to link documents to other documents or master data.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data item referenced by document properties.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for role assignment, authorizations, reader assignment, archive access, distribution, and dashboards.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual user assigned authorizations, workflow tasks, distribution, or roles.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User or user group that can view approved objects and may receive documents through distribution.

objs.name: author
objs.description: Person registered as author of a document who signs the creation step of the workflow.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: Person with additional personal change rights on a document and no relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: Person assigned to check document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: Person responsible for the document and its content who decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: Person who can translate released content into another language.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: Person who creates a document or request and may be the initiator of a workflow step.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: User group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to a group or person for a document and dependent objects.

objs.name: distribution
objs.description: Distribution list assignment of persons and user groups for a document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning while passing through the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Additional information object added to a document, released and published directly via switches in properties, not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for an existing document created and managed without affecting document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document that reaches 30 days before validity expiry and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created for a selected document to invalidate documents that have no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created for reactivation of invalidated documents.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, translation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow tasks, status, change proposals, distribution, validity extension, override, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by recipients that they have taken note of a released document version.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific or reader dashboard filled based on distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report or standard report for documents, instructions, monitoring, or acknowledgements.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated language-dependent version of released document content.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which visibility of a document can be specified.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attachment of a new information object and selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more document templates when creating a new document object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for uploading external files or generating documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and document properties.

evts.name: maintain_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata_in_document
evts.description: Automatically print certain metadata in a document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: change_released_document
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to released document content or properties, resulting in creation of a new editing version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related or person-related authorizations in the document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign an author to a document, including the creator default confirmation in the Author field.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights via the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers to a document from the reviewer selection list.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers to a document from the releaser selection list.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Additional info.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an object of type Attachment.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported approval process after document creation, attribute and content maintenance, and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the content of a document according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling workflow for all subsequent participants immediately after the first rejection.

evts.name: notify_workflow_participant
evts.description: Inform involved users of workflow task status and existence by e-mail notifications.

evts.name: document_electronic_signature
evts.description: Document individual participants' electronic signatures in the system for each released version.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new version in editing status when a valid and released document is revised.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: notify_document_author
evts.description: Inform the author of the underlying document by e-mail when a change proposal is created.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new version of the document.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned change proposals directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: notify_proposal_creator
evts.description: Notify the creator of a proposal by e-mail after editing of the assigned change proposal is documented.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before the Valid until date.

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Process a request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension, and update the Valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete the request when a revised version is released or suspension is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: Create a request for AKS or Override for a selected document in the system.

evts.name: start_override_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing a request for AKS after attachment of the request.

evts.name: check_override_request
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the first step of the override process.

evts.name: review_override
evts.description: Reviewers carry out review of the AKS.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: Releasers approve the AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare Out of force, set the last valid approved document version to Out of force, revoke rights except archive group, and start archive duration.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the folder provided and select the corresponding document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the reactivation request confirms reactivation.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new version of the invalidated document and retain metadata and properties from the time of AKS.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain persons and user groups assigned to distribution for a document.

evts.name: grant_distribution_read_authorization
evts.description: Automatically grant read authorization to user groups and persons assigned to distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request persons and users of assigned user groups by e-mail to confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement through workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: notify_author_team_of_acknowledgements
evts.description: Notify author team about unconfirmed acknowledgements and when all acknowledgements have been confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups in the distribution list per document.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Run role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents in the system.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content of the DHC VISION system into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version with workflow support so it is visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: assign_translation_participant
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing the translation in the properties dialog of the document.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_addition_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to describe a local addition, change, or extension.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference to the original document.
